title: 60-second graceful ramp under mains-fail
description: Anchors whitepaper §2.1.1 dynamic-ramp narrative with simulated data. Stage A (0–0.5 s): LIC-led peak hold while BMC propagates mains-fail to power-cap controller — 6 C per-BBU pulse, inside automotive LFP datasheet pulse spec (5–10 C). Stage B (0.5–2.0 s): linear ramp from 120 kW down to 30 kW as GPU throttles. Stage C (2.0–60 s): 30 kW continuous = 1.5 C per-BBU, inside 1–3 C continuous spec. GPU power-cap convergence time is an engineering placeholder; W3 EVT must measure on GB200 / Bluefield BMC hardware before production freezes this number (HANDOVER §6 open question).
